geometry.note: OSM building footprint (rank 11) caps confidence at approximate even though the description tag independently corroborates the ND280 identification.

method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 649337623, name 'Neutrino Monitor Building' (description tag: 'Contains T2K ND280 Detectors'), used verbatim. This is the surface access building over/beside the vertical near-detector pit (17.5 m diameter, 37 m deep per the T2K NIM paper); it is NOT the pit's own footprint, which is much smaller and has no separate OpenStreetMap trace (checked 2026-09-18).
name: J-PARC neutrino near detector hall, surface building
notes: Tolerance widened to 5%: the 280 m figure is target-to-detector-centre, while this check compares two OSM building centroids (target station building centroid to this building's centroid, measured 269.0 m) -- a different, coarser reference than the physics distance it approximates.

summary.plain: The surface building above J-PARC's near-detector pit, 280 metres from the neutrino target, holding the ND280 and INGRID detectors.
